description: Know what to actually say and do for someone who's grieving — the real help instead of the empty 'let me know if you need anything.' Use when asked what do I say to someone whose parent died, how do I support a grieving friend, what to write in a condolence, or how to help without making it worse. Points to grief resources when the person needs more than a friend can give.
